TopicEmbed.import(...)` with no limit, pagination, or use of a last-modified/etag/delta mechanism. Although `TopicEmbed.import` dedupes/updates by URL and SHA1, the job still performs O(feed_size) parsing and per-item DB lookups/writes every run, and an initial run will attempt to process the entire feed in one Sidekiq execution. This is a real scalability/performance concern grounded in the diff, not a correctness defect per se.
